attributes.visState: {"title": "[FinOps] Daily spend stacked area (LINKED_ACCOUNT)", "type": "vega", "aggs": [], "params": {"spec": "{\"$schema\": \"https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v5.json\", \"description\": \"LINKED_ACCOUNT unblended by day and account. Stacked area (Vega-Lite stacked area analogue). Not a SERVICE total.\", \"autosize\": {\"type\": \"fit\", \"contains\": \"padding\"}, \"data\": {\"url\": {\"%type%\": \"esql\", \"%context%\": true, \"%timefield%\": \"@timestamp\", \"query\": \"FROM metrics-aws.billing-default\\n| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend\\n  AND aws.billing.group_definition.key == \\\"LINKED_ACCOUNT\\\"\\n| EVAL account = CASE(\\n    COALESCE(aws.billing.group_by.LINKED_ACCOUNT, cloud.account.id) == \\\"985408759551\\\", \\\"apm-stage\\\",\\n    COALESCE(aws.billing.group_by.LINKED_ACCOUNT, cloud.account.id) == \\\"041298796264\\\", \\\"monitoring / elastic-integration\\\",\\n    COALESCE(aws.billing.group_by.LINKED_ACCOUNT, cloud.account.id) == \\\"439106060789\\\", \\\"ESF (439106060789)\\\",\\n    COALESCE(aws.billing.group_by.LINKED_ACCOUNT, cloud.account.id) == \\\"119672459156\\\", \\\"ESF (119672459156)\\\",\\n    COALESCE(aws.billing.group_by.LINKED_ACCOUNT, cloud.account.id)\\n)\\n| STATS spend = SUM(aws.billing.UnblendedCost.amount) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d), account\\n| SORT day ASC\"}}, \"mark\": {\"type\": \"area\", \"opacity\": 0.75, \"tooltip\": true}, \"encoding\": {\"x\": {\"field\": \"day\", \"type\": \"temporal\", \"title\": \"Day\"}, \"y\": {\"field\": \"spend\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"stack\": \"zero\", \"title\": \"Unblended USD\"}, \"color\": {\"field\": \"account\", \"type\": \"nominal\", \"title\": \"Account\"}}}"}}
